app.title: Pabs Chess
app.tagline: Free chess learning tools, right in your browser.

license.notice: Pabs Chess is free software, distributed under the terms of the GNU GPL v3 or later.
license.engine: Analysis powered by Stockfish, a free chess engine licensed under the GNU GPL v3.

playground.title: Engine playground
playground.description: Paste a position in FEN notation, pick a depth and a MultiPV count, and watch the analysis update as the search deepens.
playground.empty: No analysis yet. Press “Analyse” to start.
playground.sideToMoveHint: Evaluations are from the point of view of the side to move.

review.title: Game review
review.description: Paste a game in PGN format and get a move-by-move evaluation, mistake classification, accuracy and an evaluation graph.
review.graphHint: Above the line White is better, below it Black is.
review.noAlternatives: Alternatives were not computed for this move.

error.not-found: No player by that name on {{site}}.
error.empty: That player has no games we can review.
error.rate-limited: {{site}} asked us to slow down. Try again in a moment.
error.unreachable: Could not reach {{site}}. Check your connection; this can also happen if the site does not allow requests from the browser.
error.unexpected: {{site}} answered in a way we cannot read.

signal.inaccuracy: There was something better in this position.
signal.mistake: This move lets something concrete slip.
signal.blunder: This move changes the game, and not in your favour.

allows-mate.theme: Your opponent now has a forced mate.

misses-mate.theme: You had a forced mate and let it go.

hangs-piece.theme: You left a piece where your opponent can simply take it.
hangs-piece.detail: Your opponent plays {{capture}} and wins $t(pieceDef.{{piece}}) on {{square}}.

misses-material.theme: There was material to take, and you did not take it.

allows-fork.theme: Your opponent can attack two pieces with a single move.
allows-fork.detail: After {{reply}} $t(pieceDef.{{forker}}) on {{square}} hits both $t(pieceDef.{{firstPiece}}) on {{firstSquare}} and $t(pieceDef.{{secondPiece}}) on {{secondSquare}}.

weakens-king.theme: You have weakened the shelter around your king.
weakens-king.detail: The pawn on {{from}} was part of the cover for the king on {{kingSquare}}.

loses-castling.theme: You have given up the right to castle.
loses-castling.detail: The king will have to find safety another way, and that costs time.

play.title: Play the engine
play.description: Pick how much help you want, then play. The engine comments on your moves as the game goes on.

modeHelp.free: No help at all: just play.
modeHelp.coach: Every move of yours is explained, and the game carries on.
modeHelp.training: A blunder is not accepted: it is explained and you try again.
